newsitem.title: UK: Howard joins race for UK Conservative leadership.
newsitem.headline: Howard joins race for UK Conservative leadership.

text.p: Former Home Secretary Michael Howard confirmed on Tuesday that he is joining the contest for the post of leader of Britain's Conservative party.
"We must give the parliamentary party clear, principled direction and strong leadership around which all can unite," Howard told a news conference.

He becomes the fourth former cabinet minister so far bidding to succeed John Major, who announced his decision to step down hours after the Conservatives were buried by Labour in last Thursday's election landslide. The others are Kenneth Clarke, Peter Lilley and John Redwood.
